problem_type: On one paid card, 'Generate this one' (queued) and the close button (deliberately not queued) were two async actions with no shared arbiter, so interleaving them left the UI, the receipt and the vendor with different final states for the same shot
symptom: CI walkthrough agent-spend-stop-midway failed intermittently: after Generate this one and the close button were clicked back to back, the Agent turn never received the generate tool result. Same race, other order: the card showed stopped while that shot was still sealed, authorized and handed to the provider (reproduced by the characterization test at the point between admit and gate).
direct_cause: electron/capabilityCore/appIntegrationSpendConfirm.ts discardPendingSpend withdrew the offer without any token the queued confirmOneShot could see; confirmOneShot checked the card only at its start (pending re-read) and then went on through landing, lease, gate request and authorization, so a withdraw that landed between those awaits found no gate to revoke and the shot was still approved and sent. Once the shot was authorized, a late close got 'no pending generation to discard' instead of the sealed outcome.
class_root: The same operation's shots had no single linearization point: the confirm queue, the unqueued withdraw, the pending re-reads and the outcome readers each kept their own view, so any new await between them reopened the window (eight fixes in 14 days each added one more re-check).
migration: serializeCardAction/cardActionsSettled moved from spendCardActionQueue.ts into spendOperationArbiter.ts (git mv, old file gone) and gained the cancel token and the sealed-outcome reader; discardPendingSpend registers the token synchronously; confirmOneShot and the batch loop ask the same token before every side-effecting step; the Agent receipt reads the outcome through sealedOutcome. 2026-10-24 D2 step 3 (design card docs/plan/2026-10-23-d2-pointer-spend-card.md; contract docs/fixes/2026-10-24-spend-card-one-engine.root-cause.json): the paid card became node pointers plus a read-only summary that hands its shots to the canvas engine; spendOperationArbiter (registerCancel / sealedOutcome / serializeCardAction) was deleted with the old card, so this contract's boundaries, doors, tests and legacy paths were re-pointed to the code that holds the invariant today (problem, symptom, causes and class root above are the original record).
affected_population: Anyone who closes a paid card while Generate this one or Generate remaining is in flight: a shot could still be sent after the card showed stopped
The Agent turn waiting on that card: the generate tool result could be lost or contradict what the card said
entry_points: electron/productionRun/productionActionIpc.ts: hand-over-spend / discard-spend / remove-spend-shot / restore-spend-shot IPC handlers
electron/capabilityCore/appIntegrationCanvasShot.ts: the consent bind (recordHandOverBindings), the dispatch write-back (writeBackHandOver), withdrawQueuedHandOvers
electron/capabilityCore/generationTransportAdapters.ts: readPresentationOutcome (Agent receipt) and the direct-generation policy hand-over
invariants: After the user's 取消 is recorded, no shot that is not bound to a canvas Run is sent, and every bound consent still queued on the canvas is withdrawn
A shot already dispatched is sent; a late 取消 reports it as sent instead of failing
The card's answer, the Agent receipt and the ledger outcome are read from generationPresentationOutcome
The 取消 is never queued behind the action it interrupts

door_reduction.why_not: The arbiter module is gone; what replaced it are the ledger commands themselves (hand-over, bind, settle, close) with their one reducer entry each, the four IPC routes that issue them, the canvas side that binds and writes back, and the subscription that withdraws queued consents. Each door issues or reads a ledger command; none keeps its own view.

residual_risks: The ledger survives a restart but a canvas consent does not: the startup sweep withdraws open offers (no card after a restart), and a bound hand-over whose renderer died is settled from the canvas Run's job.
A 取消 that lands after a shot was dispatched cannot stop it; it is reported as sent.
Provider-side retry and offline behaviour inside the canvas batch belong to the canvas engine, not to the card.
internal_only_reason: The order in which Nomi paid-card actions and the Run ledger settle a shot has no external protocol; XState was checked (docs/plan/2026-10-10-spend-arbiter.md section 5) and does not abort in-flight awaits.

recurrence.reason: Any new paid-card action, closer or outcome reader can again act or read between two awaits; with the ledger as the linearization point there is no in-memory view left to fall out of step.
same_class_scan: rg operations.withdraw electron -> discardPendingSpend, laneExtendedDesktopPorts withdraw, stalePresentationSweep (startup); all close through the ledger

generality_proof: Every card action, every close path and every reader of the final outcome goes through ledger commands (generation.handover / .bind / .settle / withdrawPresentation) and generationPresentationOutcome; nothing depends on the model, provider, shot kind, batch size or who closes the card.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Binds a canvas Run to a hand-over only while the presentation is open and the node is the shot's landed node; after any close a bind is refused, so nothing handed over after a close can be sent.
The only place that tells a final outcome; the card's answer, the Agent receipt and the operation view read it.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Records the decision in the ledger before the renderer opens any consent (agentPanelSpendCard.e2e.test.ts).
Admitted only for the bound canvas Run; every refusal before sending settles the hand-over as not sent (agentPanelSpendCardFailures.e2e.test.ts).
Reads generationPresentationOutcome after the hand-overs settle.
Only edits the offer; it never reaches a consent or the provider.

prevention.invariant: The ledger is the one linearization point: a close refuses later binds and withdraws queued consents, and the outcome is told from one reader.
prevention.failure_mode: agentPanelSpendCardStop.e2e.test.ts goes red (a shot sent after the close, or the views disagree).
prevention.strategy: Delete the in-memory arbiter; make hand-over, bind, settle and close ledger commands; withdraw queued consents in a ledger subscription.

legacy_paths.rationale: 2026-10-24: the arbiter (queue, cancel token, sealed outcome) is deleted with the card actions it serialized; no parallel version remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: XState was evaluated and not adopted (docs/plan/2026-10-10-spend-arbiter.md section 5); no dependency added or changed.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Hand-over, bind, settle and close are ledger commands with one reducer entry each; the race test drives 取消 against 0, 1 and 3 in-flight hand-overs, a × before the bind, double clicks, typing, a closed window and a restart against the real ledger.
